And I get asked all the time, what I think is going to happen or how they can best maneuver in a quite uncertain world from their perspective. And I guess I would say a couple of things. I mean, I always start with education. There is no way to prevent change happening in the world. We are seeing it at an increasingly rapid pace. We have no idea what artificial intelligence is going to do to us for us going forward. And just to be as well educated, to be as well prepared as you possibly can, because that's the only insurance policy that you have to try to navigate a fast-changing world like the one we are in. Secondly, get off your screens, get out into the real world, spend time with real people, your friends, neighbors, volunteer at your church or synagogue or community organization, and be a really careful consumer of social media.
